review_method: Opened approved base PNG and all four final 1024x1024 PNGs individually through the image reader; separately decoded every PNG with Pillow and checked against projected actual mesh polygons.
observations: All four show the unchanged two-by-two-by-two ore cluster at the same camera position and size, with straight cyan glowing outer edges and block-grid seams.
The real voxel-thick diamond pickaxe visibly swivels between candidates. Its terminal edge stays touching the same upper-left-front ore corner.
All pickaxe and ore geometry remains inside the image; no clipping, motion lines, swing arcs or extra luminous strokes are visible.
Charcoal background, ore textures, cyan outline, camera and lighting remain the approved design. Any rendered occlusion/shadow changes result from the requested pickaxe rotation.
